boundaries: All promoted statements are exact finite representation, channel, graph, projector, spectral, or combinatorial results, except the explicitly labelled 64-seed nonlinear census and heuristic crossing-order optimization.

No derived Standard Model, fabricated CORNERSTONE chip, measured decoder or pattern, physical antiferromagnet, quantum-walk processor, exceptional-point sensor, gravity, cosmology, or theory of everything is claimed.

pass4121_explicit_145_gauge_matrices.boundary: Exact generator construction and anomaly/intertwiner audit. The repair options are representation architectures, not a dynamical chiral gauge theory.
pass4121_explicit_145_gauge_matrices.correction: The anomaly cancellation in Pass 4105 applied only to the abstract multiplicity-space generation. Once the explicit 145x145 gauge matrices act identically across V15 and V24, those orbital dimensions multiply the chiral species and the full carrier is anomalous.
pass4121_explicit_145_gauge_matrices.equal_weight_theorem: For the standard Q,u^c,d^c,L,e^c charges with no exotics, simultaneous SU3^3, SU3^2U1, SU2^2U1 and gravitational-U1 cancellation forces q=u=d=l=e. Therefore every multiplet must carry the same W33 multiplicity.

minimal_repairs.break_PSp_rank_one_embedding: Select one vector in each nontrivial W33 sector, gauge only a 15-dimensional one-generation subspace, and leave 130 states gauge-singlet; this breaks PSp(4,3).

pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.boundary: Exact channel factorization. Number-conserving logical compilation is specified, but fault-tolerant state preparation and universal gates are open.
pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.collective_weight_DFS_no_go: A code contained in one Hamming-weight sector is exactly decoherence-free but the desired collective phase is only a global scalar, so it cannot implement a nontrivial logical phase.
pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.factorization: After a basis pairing, the code is clock_qubit tensor payload, the ideal collective phase is e^(ir phi) diag(1,e^(i phi)) on the clock and identity on payload, and the noisy channel is the one-use z_1 channel on the clock tensor identity on payload.
pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.highlight: N=31 carries one phase clock plus 28 protected payload qubits in 31 modes; error 7.3646628264e-5 versus 5.5087125884e-2 for direct 29-qubit injection, a factor 747.99.
pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.odd_block: For N=2r+1, pair H_r and H_(r+1), whose dimensions are both C(N,r).
pass4122_relational_phase_subsystem.payload_protection: All payload coherences are exact; reference error is independent of payload dimension.

pass4123_graph_aware_decoder.boundary: Exact fixed-parameter decoder for up to three errors. Sensor calibration and larger-sparsity scaling remain open.
pass4123_graph_aware_decoder.candidate_edges: Union all unique Levi paths of length at most three between threshold vertices.
pass4123_graph_aware_decoder.complexity: At most 1+20+C(20,2)+C(20,3)=1351 least-squares candidates after local path generation, instead of 682641 global candidates.
pass4123_graph_aware_decoder.leaf_theorem: Every component of the three-edge forest has nonzero leaf syndromes above threshold under the certified amplitude condition; every true edge lies on a unique path of length at most three between detected leaves.

balanced_ordering.optimization_status: heuristic balanced annealing; not a proof of optimality

pass4124_cornerstone_foundry_audit.boundary: Foundry-specific feasibility audit using public PDK/platform figures and explicit design assumptions; no GDS, DRC, S-parameter simulation, or fabricated chip.
hard_blockers: The standard public SOI340 basic-cell list exposes MMI, MZI, heater, bend and waveguide cells but no platform-certified crossing with measured S-parameters.
Spatial path encoding requires 480 selector/recombiner MMIs, not six total couplers.
Six selector-phase planes require 480 optical phase shifters unless a common-mode phase technology is introduced.
Independent calibration exceeds the referenced 120-DC packaging capacity.
Conservative strip propagation plus five signal uses is incompatible with a low-loss single-photon architecture.
pass4124_cornerstone_foundry_audit.platform: CORNERSTONE 340 nm SOI, 1550 nm TE strip
pass4124_cornerstone_foundry_audit.verdict: Logical routing is exact, but the naive spatial CORNERSTONE SOI340 implementation is not tapeout-ready. A low-loss SiN passive layer plus active phase layer, or time/frequency serialization, is required.

pass4125_nonlinear_attractor_orbits.boundary: Numerical finite-seed census with exact group stabilizer audits for the bivalent representatives; it is not a proof that every attractor has been found.
pass4125_nonlinear_attractor_orbits.census: 64 deterministic Gaussian seeds per selector, BDF to t=500, quotient by PSp(4,3) and global field inversion, coordinates rounded at 1e-6 for numerical orbit matching.
pass4125_nonlinear_attractor_orbits.correction: The earlier seed-42 pure-sector result remains correct, but cubic saturation does not globally preserve a single Laplacian eigenspace; mixed attractors occupy additional symmetry orbits.
pass4125_nonlinear_attractor_orbits.group: PSp(4,3), order 25920, generated by the 40 projective symplectic transvections
